unit: F025 + F026 — the article authoring surface
batchRationale: Both are founder-screenshot defects on ONE surface, both OPEN, both tracked as #170, neither gated by a dependency, a founder decision or a protected boundary. Fixing one without the other would have left the same screen half-corrected.
stateNote: NOT terminal. Both carry a register 'Cert req'd: Y' column, so live certification remains owed and is NOT claimed here. Recorded in the execution layer; Stage-0 currentState OPEN is preserved verbatim for both.

F025.finding: Article image insertion shows raw markdown to the author instead of a rendered image.
F025.defectAsFound: _insertImage wrote `![image](<delivery url>)` into a plain TextField. The only rendered view was behind a Write/Preview MODE TOGGLE, so an author who inserted an image saw a line of raw markdown and had to leave writing to find out whether the right image had landed.
F025.fix: The rendered view became a PANE rather than a MODE. On a viewport with room for it (>= 1000px) the editor is source on the left and a live render on the right, so an inserted image appears the instant it is added and the render tracks every keystroke. Below that width the toggle remains — two cramped columns would be worse than one — and a successful insert raises 'Image added' with a one-tap Preview action, so the author is never left staring at markdown with no way to check it.
F025.deliberatelyNotDone: The written markdown was NOT changed. The durability and correctness of the written URL is F121's subject; rewriting the URL form here would have silently taken a position on another finding.
F025.notInvented: No second renderer. The pane draws the body through AuraPublicationMarkdown and the title through AuraPublicationTitle — the same two primitives that publish the article — so what the author sees while writing IS what publishes.

F026.finding: Pasting a title into the article editor oversizes it.
F026.defectAsFound: Two causes at once. SHAPE: a title pasted from a document brought its newlines with it, and each newline consumed a whole line of a two-line box. SIZE: the field and the published article both rendered at a fixed AuraText.display 40px, so a long headline clipped inside the field while writing and ran past its column once published.
F026.fix: One authority — lib/core/ui/publication/aura_publication_title.dart. normalizePublicationTitle collapses shape whitespace; PublicationTitleInputFormatter applies it to typing AND paste; publicationTitleFontSize steps the size down with LENGTH as well as viewport, monotonically, to a floor that still reads as a title. The editor field, the editor's preview and the published article all draw from it, so a title cannot be one size while written and another once published.
F026.authorsWordsAreTheirs: Shape only. No word is removed, nothing is truncated, and a trailing single space is preserved so typing a space between words still works — the formatter runs on every keystroke.
F026.convergenceBeyondTheFinding: The announcement editor's title field now uses the same formatter. A title is one line of text on every publication surface; leaving the sibling editor accepting pasted newlines would have re-created the defect one screen over. Deliberate and recorded — F026 names the article editor.
